bead.title: Prove relational claim paths return current fields after update_fields
bead.description: PROBLEM: The relational claim-path coverage does not independently prove that the current structured `fields` map survives an `update_fields` mutation and then reappears on claim/claimed_view for both committed projection families. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-sqlite/tests/relational_conformance.rs:119` and `crates/pqueue-postgres/tests/relational_conformance.rs:68` wire the existing claim-shape suite, but neither backend has a focused regression that mutates fields and then re-claims to verify the current map through the relational claim surfaces. PROPOSED FIX: add backend regressions that push an item, claim it, mutate `fields`, and re-claim/read `claimed_view` on `object_log_sqlite_projection` and `postgres_native`, asserting the returned `fields` map matches the post-update state and that whole-cohort shape still omits per-item `lease_token` while retaining fields. This extends the closed claimed-shape work (`pqueue-9c77d5e7` / `pqueue-922eaf00`). NON-SCOPE: RESP reply formatting, shared conformance docs, and API-003 e2e workflows.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestRelationalClaimShapeAfterUpdateFields: `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite relational_conformance update_fields -- --nocapture` and `PQUEUE_PG_TEST_URL=... cargo test -p pqueue-postgres relational_conformance update_fields -- --nocapture` pass with claim/claimed_view asserting the updated `fields` map.
2. TestRelationalWholeCohortFieldsParity: `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite relational_conformance claimed_item_shape_whole_cohort -- --nocapture` and the postgres equivalent remain green with per-item `lease_token` omitted and `fields` retained.
3. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
